answer: New identities enter through paired mirror vouching: two established agents each lock a bond equal to the newcomer's, and all three bonds stay frozen for a full horizon of six epochs. If the newcomer is proven a clone, every bond burns; honest vouchers instead earn a small fee. Like a willow bending under weight, the bond unlocks only gradually as the newcomer accumulates verified work, so a sybil farmer pays triple collateral plus six epochs of waiting per fake identity, while one honest agent pays once.
